title: Isaiah 45:7 KJV and Hebrew provenance

scripture.text: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these things.
scripture.note: KJV wording preserved without replacing evil with calamity

lexemes.gloss: bad, evil, distress or calamity depending on context

interpretation.description: The author compares the verse's contrasts with yin and yang, Santa and Reaper, and White Dog and Black Dog. This is an attributed creative comparison, not a statement that these traditions share historical origins or identical theology.

unresolved: Contextual range of ra in Isaiah 45:7 should not be reduced to one universal English definition.
A documented historical link between Isaiah 45:7 and yin-yang has not been established.
The original wording and date of the creator's Santa/Reaper interpretation require source-level confirmation.
